# The startup sanitizer receives compose and mail without a null array entry

The owned change removes the nullptr third entry from acceptableParams and keeps compose and mail. The accepted do_main passes that array to EnsureCommandlineSafe before XRE_main; the earlier xpcshell branch returns separately. The paired Gecko helper was not inspected, so this caller proof does not establish its template contract or a fresh crash-fix result.

Scope: Application startup argument sanitation.
